name: power_plant_cooling_river
title: 1 GW steam plant cooled by a river (exercise 1)
summary: Teaching exercise: a 1 GW steam plant is taken at half the Carnot efficiency between 550 °C and the saturation temperature at 10 kPa. The condenser heat is rejected to a river, and the model returns the river temperature rise.
